name: Guided image edit
description: Edit one source Image from an explicit instruction and optional guidance Image.
instructionTemplate: Edit exactly the supplied source Image according to the user's instruction. Treat an optional guidance Image only as reference or mask guidance for the requested change. Preserve every source fact that the instruction does not explicitly change. Do not add text, branding, UI chrome, or explanatory overlays unless the instruction explicitly requires visible text. Return only clean edited Image candidates.
outputRequirements: Return only edited Image candidates derived from the bound source Image.
Preserve unrequested composition, identity, lighting, and content.
Use the optional guidance Image only for the declared edit.
Do not claim approval or select a final result on behalf of the user.
